reasons: Financial pressure 4 of 4: all pressure flags present (going concern, covenant problem, incentive pay tied to revenue/EPS, capital raise). Severe distress with incentive-linked pay gives strong motive to manipulate results.

Internal control and audit 2 of 4: two of material weakness, adverse ICFR opinion, auditor change and disagreement are present. That means weak controls and/or auditor friction, so misstatement is more likely to happen and go undetected.
Transaction complexity 1 of 8: only one complexity flag, so there are limited judgmental areas in which to hide manipulation.
Corrections 0 of 3, investigations 0 of 3 and management turnover 0 of 2: no restatement, regulatory or litigation signals and no executive churn, which tempers the score.
Numeric warning signals 0 of 4 computable: Beneish, Dechow, accruals and cash-conversion screens did not flag, although distressed firms often show losses that weaken these screens.
